gloss: to draw (someone) close; to pull into one's arms

definitions.gloss: to draw someone close; to pull into one's arms
definitions.explanation: To pull someone toward oneself and hold them, a gentle, protective movement.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|だ}き{寄|よ}せる。
examples.english: To draw a child into one's arms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{泣|な}いている→泣く：00655_naku⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|だ}き{寄|よ}せた。
examples.english: He put his arm around her shoulders and drew her close as she cried.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雷|かみなり}→雷：02197_kaminari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{怖|こわ}⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦そっと→そっと：03321_sotto⟧{抱|だ}き{寄|よ}せた。
examples.english: When the thunder rolled, Mother gently drew my frightened little brother close.

notes:
⟦{抱|だ}く→抱く：02131_daku⟧ (to hold) + ⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧ (to bring near).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|だ}き{寄|よ}せる; ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抱|だ}き{寄|よ}せる, to put an arm round someone's shoulders and pull them close

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抱|だ}きしめる→抱きしめる：06044_dakishimeru⟧: to hug tightly; {抱|だ}き{寄|よ}せる is the movement of drawing someone in, often just before the hug
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{寄|よ}せる→引き寄せる：06046_hikiyoseru⟧: to pull something toward oneself, with no embrace
